# Tutoring Jedi

> Tutoring Jedi (tutoringjedi.ca) offers one-on-one SAT, ACT, GRE and GMAT tutoring, university admissions counselling, high school Math and Physics tutoring and university Statistics tutoring. Based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Sessions are in person in Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area (including North York, Markham, Thornhill and Richmond Hill) and online worldwide by video call. All sessions are taught by founder Neil Chakraborty.

Key facts:

- Tutor: Neil Chakraborty, founder and lead tutor, with 25+ years of experience. MS and MPhil (University of Utah), M.Sc. and B.Sc. in Physics, Adjunct Professor at Seneca Polytechnic, PMP and SAS certified.
- Format: one-on-one only, with the same tutor every session. In person in Toronto and the GTA, or online anywhere.
- Average results reported by Tutoring Jedi: 100–150 point SAT gains, 5–10 point ACT gains, 70–100 point GRE and GMAT gains. 2,000+ students helped.
- Admissions results: students admitted to Harvard, Stanford, Yale, UPenn, UChicago, Northwestern, UC Berkeley, Oxford, the University of Toronto, UBC and McGill.
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM (Toronto time).
- Contact: tutoringjedi@gmail.com. A free 30-minute consultation can be booked at https://tutoringjedi.ca/Contact.html

## Test prep

- [SAT tutoring](https://tutoringjedi.ca/SAT.html): digital SAT prep in Toronto and online
- [ACT tutoring](https://tutoringjedi.ca/ACT.html): Enhanced ACT prep in Toronto and online, with current test dates
- [GRE tutoring](https://tutoringjedi.ca/GRE.html): GRE prep for graduate school applicants
- [GMAT tutoring](https://tutoringjedi.ca/GMAT.html): GMAT Focus Edition prep for MBA applicants
- [Test prep in Toronto and the GTA](https://tutoringjedi.ca/test-prep-tutoring-toronto.html): SAT, ACT, GRE and GMAT tutoring by area (Toronto, North York, Markham, Thornhill, Richmond Hill, online)

## Other services

- [University admissions counselling](https://tutoringjedi.ca/university-admissions.html): undergraduate and MBA applications in the US, Canada, UK and beyond
- [High school Math and Physics](https://tutoringjedi.ca/highschool-math-physics.html): Grades 7–12, including the Ontario curriculum
- [University Statistics](https://tutoringjedi.ca/university-statistics.html): Statistics, Research Methods, Business Analytics and Machine Learning
